    getDefaultValue() - Method in class msfx.lib.md.Column
    Returns the default value of the column, which is, in order: The default value explicitly set. The first possible value, if the column has possible values. The default value of the type, see Types.getDefaultValue(Types, int).
    getDefaultValue(Types, int) - Static method in enum class msfx.lib.md.Types
    Returns the default value of a type, used when a column has no explicit default value: BOOLEAN: false. DECIMAL: zero with the given number of decimals, e.g. 0.00 for 2. DOUBLE, INTEGER, LONG: zero. STRING: an empty string. DATE, TIME, DATETIME, BINARY, OBJECT: a null value of the type. Numbers and booleans never default to null, so that they can be defined as NOT NULL.
